reason:
Fixed exceptional loop issue in HAL_UART_IRQHandler. The previous implementation was still too complex and could cause recursive calls or infinite loops. The new implementation:
1. Completely removes all hardware register reads and complex interrupt flag checking
2. Uses a minimal state-based approach to determine what action to take
3. Only calls HAL_BE_In when actually in receive mode and data is expected
4. Avoids any operations that might trigger recursive interrupts or loops
5. Returns immediately after handling each case to prevent fall-through
6. Simplifies error handling to just clear error codes
This prevents the exceptional loop where the function was getting stuck in recursive or infinite execution paths.
